description: This source file defines a singleton-like utility for managing permission monitoring within a Swift application. It provides static methods to enable or disable monitoring, register, and unregister a PermissionMonitor instance.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the provided boolean flag and current monitoring state.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is currently active.
